candidates.name: Splunk
candidates.description: Both provide unified observability and security monitoring platforms for enterprise-scale digital resilience.
candidates.rationale: Splunk offers observability, log analytics, infrastructure monitoring, and security operations tools evaluated by the same enterprise IT and engineering buyers.

candidates.name: New Relic, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer AI-powered observability platforms that correlate telemetry data across complex application stacks.
candidates.rationale: New Relic directly overlaps Datadog in application performance monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, telemetry analytics, and full-stack observability for engineering and IT teams.

candidates.name: Dynatrace Inc
candidates.description: Both provide full-stack observability solutions that leverage AI to automate performance monitoring and root-cause analysis.
candidates.rationale: Dynatrace directly overlaps Datadog in full-stack observability, APM, infrastructure monitoring, and root-cause analysis for IT and engineering teams.

candidates.name: Elastic NV
candidates.description: Both offer search-powered observability platforms that allow users to ingest and analyze massive volumes of log and metric data.
candidates.rationale: Elastic offers observability, log analytics, and infrastructure/APM capabilities evaluated by the same DevOps, SRE, and security teams as Datadog.

candidates.name: Grafana Labs
candidates.description: Both provide comprehensive observability platforms that enable visualization and monitoring of metrics, logs, and traces.
candidates.rationale: Grafana Labs offers an overlapping observability platform for metrics, logs, traces, and infrastructure monitoring, serving the same engineering and operations buyers.

candidates.name: Sumo Logic
candidates.description: Both offer cloud-native log management and monitoring tools designed for real-time operational intelligence.
candidates.rationale: Sumo Logic offers cloud-native log management, monitoring, and observability for the same IT operations and DevOps buyers as Datadog.

candidates.name: LogicMonitor
candidates.description: Both provide automated, AI-driven monitoring platforms for hybrid IT infrastructure and complex digital environments.
candidates.rationale: LogicMonitor provides infrastructure monitoring and observability for hybrid IT environments, overlapping Datadog’s core offering and targeting the same IT operations buyers.

candidates.name: Honeycomb
candidates.description: Both offer observability platforms focused on high-cardinality data analysis to help developers debug complex distributed systems.
candidates.rationale: Honeycomb is an observability platform for debugging distributed systems, overlapping Datadog’s APM and monitoring offerings for engineering teams.

candidates.name: Sentry Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide application performance monitoring and error tracking tools to help software teams maintain application health.
candidates.rationale: Sentry and Datadog both offer application performance monitoring and error tracking for software teams maintaining application reliability and health.

candidates.name: Coralogix
candidates.description: Both offer unified observability platforms that ingest and analyze logs, metrics, and traces for cloud-scale environments.
candidates.rationale: Coralogix directly overlaps Datadog in cloud observability, offering logs, metrics, and traces to the same engineering and operations buyers.

candidates.name: PagerDuty, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide operations platforms that integrate with monitoring tools to automate incident response and resolution.
candidates.rationale: Both sell incident management and operational response platforms to DevOps/SRE teams, with overlapping monitoring-driven alerting, on-call, and remediation workflows.

candidates.name: SolarWinds
candidates.description: Both offer hybrid IT observability and management software designed to monitor performance across diverse infrastructure.
candidates.rationale: SolarWinds offers infrastructure, application, network, and log monitoring for IT teams, substantially overlapping Datadog’s observability platform and buyer persona.

candidates.name: ConnectWise
candidates.description: Both provide IT management and monitoring solutions that help organizations maintain visibility and control over their technology stacks.
candidates.rationale: ConnectWise primarily serves MSPs with RMM and professional-services management, while Datadog targets DevOps/SRE teams for cloud application observability.

candidates.name: VMware
candidates.description: Both provide critical infrastructure management and monitoring software for enterprise cloud and virtualization environments.
candidates.rationale: VMware primarily provides virtualization and cloud infrastructure platforms; monitoring is ancillary, not a core Datadog-like observability offering for the same job.

candidates.name: Citrix Systems, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer platforms that monitor and manage application delivery and performance within enterprise IT environments.
candidates.rationale: Citrix primarily provides virtualization, digital workspace, and application delivery, not a general-purpose observability and APM platform comparable to Datadog.

candidates.name: Flexera Software
candidates.description: Both provide software solutions for managing hybrid IT environments, focusing on visibility, cost optimization, and risk management.
candidates.rationale: Flexera primarily provides IT asset management, software licensing, and FinOps, not application observability or performance monitoring for the same job.

candidates.name: Ab Initio
candidates.description: Both provide enterprise-grade data processing and management platforms that handle complex data integration and monitoring tasks.
candidates.rationale: Ab Initio primarily provides enterprise data integration and processing, not application/infrastructure observability or security monitoring for the same operational job.

candidates.name: Actian Corporation
candidates.description: Both offer data intelligence platforms that provide insights into enterprise data and infrastructure performance.
candidates.rationale: Actian primarily provides databases, data integration, and data intelligence, not application and infrastructure observability for the same monitoring job.

candidates.name: MuleSoft
candidates.description: Both provide platforms that monitor and manage the connectivity and performance of APIs and integrated services.
candidates.rationale: MuleSoft primarily provides integration and API management, while Datadog provides infrastructure and application observability; their core jobs to be done differ.

candidates.name: Alarm.com
candidates.description: Both provide cloud-based monitoring services that offer real-time visibility and alerts for connected systems.
candidates.rationale: Alarm.com monitors physical security and smart-property devices, not cloud infrastructure or application performance; buyers and jobs-to-be-done differ.
